text: {"status":"answered","premise":"none","claims":[{"text":"يشمل المشروع ثلاث منصات رئيسية.","kind":"fact","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"OVR-p2-s4","quote":"The initiative covers three main platforms: the Almamlaka TV mobile application (iOS and Android), the web streaming portal, and integration with third-party smart TV platforms."}]},{"text":"المنصة الأولى هي تطبيق Almamlaka TV للهواتف المحمولة على نظامي iOS وAndroid.","kind":"fact","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"OVR-p2-s4","quote":"The initiative covers three main platforms: the Almamlaka TV mobile application (iOS and Android), the web streaming portal, and integration with third-party smart TV platforms."}]},{"text":"المنصة الثانية هي بوابة البث عبر الويب.","kind":"fact","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"OVR-p2-s4","quote":"The initiative covers three main platforms: the Almamlaka TV mobile application (iOS and Android), the web streaming portal, and integration with third-party smart TV platforms."}]},{"text":"المنصة الثالثة هي التكامل مع منصات التلفزيون الذكي التابعة لجهات خارجية.","kind":"fact","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"OVR-p2-s4","quote":"The initiative covers three main platforms: the Almamlaka TV mobile application (iOS and Android), the web streaming portal, and integration with third-party smart TV platforms."}]},{"text":"ستحصل كل منصة على واجهة مستخدم معاد تصميمها بما يتوافق مع إرشادات العلامة التجارية المحدّثة.","kind":"fact","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"OVR-p2-s4","quote":"Each platform will receive a redesigned user interface aligned with the updated Almamlaka TV brand guidelines."}]}],"conflicts":[],"missing":[],"clarifying_question":"","clarify_options":[]}
